text: Residents have shared concerns about speeding on Rhodes Avenue, north of Fairford Avenue. This is a residential street, near an elementary school. Residents submitted a petition with 23 signatures in support of speed humps. In a confidential follow up ballot, there was 65 percent support from households on the affected stretch for the installation of these traffic calming measures. I am supportive of the installation of speed humps.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (five speed humps) on Rhodes Avenue, between Fairford Avenue and the north end of Rhodes Avenue, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Paula Fletcher.
